# Filament Sanchaya

> Filament Sanchaya is a Filament v5 file manager and media picker for Laravel applications, with upload modals, media selection, file attachments, metadata, storage disk support, soft deletes, trash recovery, and configurable actions.

Filament Sanchaya is published as the Composer package `dp0/filament-sanchaya`. The canonical documentation site is `https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/`, and the latest documented release is v1.1.2.

## Documentation

- [Filament Sanchaya homepage](https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/): Product overview, release video, current documentation link, and changelog.
- [v1.1 series documentation](https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/v1.1.0/): Includes configurable storage paths, picker-scoped directories, chunked uploads, and v1.1.1–v1.1.2 fixes for Trash, picker selection, and uploads into root-level folders.
- [v1.0.2 documentation](https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/v1.0.2/): Installation, configuration, plugin registration, authorization, file manager, media picker, trash, attachments, actions, extensibility, testing, and troubleshooting.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/dp-0/filament-sanchaya): Source code, issues, releases, and contribution history.
- [Composer package](https://packagist.org/packages/dp0/filament-sanchaya): Composer package metadata and install command.

## Release Information

- [Latest documentation version](https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/v1.1.0/): Current documentation for the v1.1 series, including v1.1.2.
- [Sitemap](https://filament-sanchaya.dineshphuyel.com.np/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search engines.
